story.subject: BOLD Snacks
story.factualCorrection: Use Grupo Ferrero/Ferrero do Brasil. Do not call the buyer Ferrara. Ferrara is an affiliated company in the broader Ferrero ecosystem, but the announced buyer of BOLD is Grupo Ferrero.
narrativeArc: origem e primeira tese ligada a performance/crossfit
primeira tentativa com suplementos e falta de tração
pivot para barras de proteína e reposicionamento colorido
marketing digital, creators e o hábito de aquecer a barra no micro-ondas
pandemia, aceleração de demanda e rupturas de estoque
verticalização industrial e expansão da fábrica em Divinópolis
escala nacional e ampliação de portfólio
acordo/aquisição pelo Grupo Ferrero e novo capítulo
story.benchmark: Fernando Miranda storytelling mechanics: surpresa -> origem -> conflito -> decisão -> mecanismo -> consequência -> lição de gestão

mustUse: Gabriel Ferreira quando a narração falar do fundador
BOLD real products/packaging when the narration talks about product/positioning
BOLD Divinópolis factory/exterior/operations when talking about verticalization and scale
real BOLD production/process footage when discussing production
real BOLD team/community/retail presence when discussing growth
Ferrero/BOLD official acquisition material when discussing the transaction
forbidden: generic stock food/factory footage standing in for BOLD
black background + static logo as primary scene
visualContract.stillImageRule: Stills may support the story, but at least 35% of longform screen time and at least 25% of shortform screen time must be real motion footage when rights/provenance are acceptable.

audioContract.tts: one complete narration beat per scene; captions never segment TTS

music.style: light modern instrumental, warm, no vocals

audioContract.ducking: music audible but always below narration

tiktok.angle: faster hook, tighter transitions, same factual arc

linkedin.angle: executive version: product-market fit, operations, verticalization, brand building, transaction

youtube.angle: complete story with chapters and 3 management lessons
